package.author: Nuvio Media
package.description: A desktop media app for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Browse, organize, and play media from sources you add.

en-US.author: Nuvio Media
en-US.description: A desktop media app for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Browse, organize, and play media from sources you add.
en-US.longDescription: Nuvio Desktop is a media client for browsing metadata, managing collections and watch progress, downloading media, and playing streams from user-installed extensions or user-provided sources.
en-US.name: Nuvio Desktop
en-US.releaseNotes:
